title: Mold Remediation Price Schedule: Haul-Off Line Amount
content:
**Schedule entry.** On a Mold Remediation job, the removed square feet are the total quantity of the drywall removal lines and the total quantity of the insulation removal lines booked on the job. The haul-off loads are the drywall and insulation removed square feet together divided by the drywall load capacity of 160 square feet per load and rounded up to a whole load, and the haul-off line amount is the loads times the tier's debris disposal fee per load, rounded to the cent, half up.

**Pricing basis for this line.** For the bagged debris haul-off line, and only for that line, the amount is figured as this schedule sets it; the pre-removal asbestos sampling line and the work-plan visit line are priced under their own schedules, and every other scope line remains billed at the tier's unit rate for its code times the quantity performed, with labor the customer asks to have performed in the after-hours window billed at the hourly rate times the after-hours labor multiplier.

**Assembly.** The loads are multiplied by the per-load fee, every charge added to the haul-off line is then added, and the total is rounded once to the cent, half up.

**Warranty work.** A company warranty job is performed at no charge and carries no haul-off line; its haul-off figure is 0.00 and nothing is booked.

| Removed square feet together (hypothetical) | Divided by 160 | Loads |
|---|---|---|
| 160 | 1.00 | 1 |
| 161 | 1.01 | 2 |
| 365 | 2.28 | 3 |

**Worked example, hypothetical inputs.** 290 square feet of drywall removal and 75 square feet of insulation removal give 365 square feet, which is 3 loads; on a tier whose debris disposal fee per load were 205.00, the line is 3 multiplied by 205.00, which is 615.00.
